status: S2 proposal only; not a patch to the baseline and not approved hardware
label: ASSUMED

provenance.inheritance: All ratings and numeric leaves inherit ASSUMED. mechanismSources support mechanisms, not these ratings. S2 source IDs resolve in precedents.md; others in References/BIBLIOGRAPHY.md.
provenance.format: equipment uses the existing 1C assembly keys, planar position and scalar intrinsicInertia (Izz). tetherProposal holds explicit proposed 3D and dynamic extensions; current loader cannot consume those extensions unchanged.
provenance.massPolicy: Add 255 kg; do not silently subtract it from habitat-structure. All line, head, bobbin, electronics, stored-energy devices and thermal ballast are within these masses. No spare head or line.

equipment.redundancy: One dorsal load frame tied into pressure-hull structural rings; not an appendage hinge
equipment.failureProtection: Retain actual extension on motor loss. Rated sacrificial tensile link protects the hull load path; not a random failure roll.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

equipment.redundancy: One geared motor, capstan and level-wind; separate mechanical brake remains on electrical failure
equipment.failureProtection: Current limit and thermal trip; stall converts actual supplied power to heat, never to fictitious line motion. Mechanical jam may defeat payout.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

equipment.redundancy: 20 kg line plus 5 kg detachable bobbin/carrier, one cassette
equipment.failureProtection: Track remaining line and worn material coordinates; no replenishment on region change.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

equipment.redundancy: 20 kg launcher plus one 15 kg enclosing, spring-closing grapple; passive visual latch witness
equipment.failureProtection: Mechanical safing and closure geometry; no adhesion to arbitrary surfaces and no remote powered unlatch.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

equipment.redundancy: Passive friction brake and mechanical slip setting; actuator power included in controller
equipment.failureProtection: Off means no electricity, not disengaged brake. Actual friction work heats this node. Brake fade changes torque; ratings never cap collision force by magic.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

equipment.redundancy: Ship-side openable fairlead/cassette latch, two independent cutter initiators, one charged energy store and essential command path
equipment.failureProtection: Stored energy operates release through payload loss; common essential decoder/store failure remains possible. Cutters do not restore spent line or head.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

equipment.redundancy: Fairlead load cell, metering-wheel payout counter, shaft counter and local camera; existing IMUs are an independent consistency check
equipment.failureProtection: Expose saturation, disagreement, missing power and stale observations; a shaft counter does not prove actual line motion.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

equipment.redundancy: Local measured-tension servo, brake-setting actuator and essential release decoder; no autonomous trajectory planner
equipment.failureProtection: Power loss freezes the mechanical brake setting; unknown sensors inhibit powered retrieval but do not generate a true tension reading.
equipment.label: ASSUMED

tetherProposal.label: ASSUMED
tetherProposal.frame: Right-handed body frame, +x nose, +y left, +z dorsal; all coordinates relative to structural datum
tetherProposal.intrinsicTensorPolicy: For study arithmetic only, new assemblies use diag(intrinsicInertia) at their centroid. Replace with measured CAD tensors on adoption.

line.material: Nonconductive braided aramid-class rope with abrasion jacket; effective packaged mass, axial rigidity and termination strength are assumed, not a named qualified product.

tetherProposal.releasePolicy: Only after the head is launched: release opens the ship fairlead and disconnects the cassette with remaining wound line. All 40 kg of head+line+carrier is then outside the rigid inventory (some already deployed). Preserve existing momentum and apply a 1 J relative ejection from the 40 J capacitor actuation with opposite ship recoil. Cut removes the head and paid-out line only; residual line+carrier remain aboard. No remote head unlatch, new equipment or free rewind.
tetherProposal.runtimeAccounting: Listed motor and charge modes are rated endpoints, not constant power/heat. Heat=actual electrical input-minus mechanical/stored export plus friction work. Passive brake heat T*dL/dt is additional even when electrical mode is off. Line/head mass transfers out of the rigid ship as paid/launched; never count it in both rigid inertia and flexible dynamics.
